name: Patrie's Raspberries on the Prairie
description: Patrie's Raspberries on the Prairie is a berry farm in Bowdon, ND. Visitors come for Raspberries, best in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Sep in this growing zone.
Contact the farm directly to confirm current hours and what is ready to pick.
